text: Core ctx API published in S0-PLT-01 summary; see src/core/*.mjs

Please mount module service(ctx) exports at ctx.modules.<name>, bind ctx to evt.tenantId in bus handlers, dedupe via consumed_events, and register /auth/token, /auth/me, /audit in core per architecture/contracts/modules.md

Security asks for src/core (from S1-SEC-01 threat model): (1) store.mjs: reject quoted/backtick/schema-qualified tenant-table names and tenant_id in UPDATE SET/update() patch; (2) tenant-context.mjs: do not spread raw/system into tctx.db; (3) server.mjs: devMode must default false (dev token endpoint mints platform_admin for any tenant); (4) auth.mjs: reject tokens for unknown tenants, audit X-Tenant-Id overrides; (5) log.mjs: redact free-text keys (description, body, narrative, injury) and error strings

S1-PLT-02 done: optionalDependencies pinned @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk 0.20.2 and @google/genai 2.27.0 (latest published on/before 2026-10-04), package-lock.json via npm install, both imports verified, docs/licenses.md (50 pkgs, only fast-sha256 Unlicense flagged), src/core/scheduler.mjs createScheduler().every(ms,fn,{name}) with unref/stopAll/error isolation/overlap skip, 6 tests pass. Not wired into server.mjs.
S2-PLT-01 done: ctx.scheduler wired (stopAll on close), outbox.seq migration (core.bus:2, window backfill, unique tenant_id+seq), scripts/smoke.mjs + CI Smoke step; 37 core tests pass
S2-PLT-02 done: Dockerfile, .dockerignore, infra/cloudrun/service.yaml, docs/deployment.md, deployment-files test (5 pass); nothing run against GCP

S2-ARC-01 referrals (not contract changes): (1) store.mjs/tenant-context.mjs tenant-filter bypass and tenant_id row move (threat-modeler R1/R3); (2) log.mjs REDACT misses dateOfBirth, injuryDescription, description, body, ip, licence; (3) deferred enc:v2:<keyId> ciphertext for per-tenant rotation; (4) optional HOST env in server main; (5) outbox seq as documented in modules.md core (column name seq, per-tenant MAX+1 in publish txn, unique, never reused); limit/after on bus.outbox deferred.
